methodology.normalization: Outcome-blind within-cohort per-gene z-score across samples after log2(x + 1) transformation of raw/FPKM/TPM/RPKM/linear intensity matrices
methodology.cross_validation: 10x5 Repeated Stratified K-Fold Nested Cross-Validation (inner 3-fold L2 C-grid [0.05, 0.2, 1.0, 5.0], outer out-of-fold probability aggregation)
methodology.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (bh_q) computed across all cohort-axis tests within each Gate
methodology.bootstrap_ci: 1,000-iteration stratified bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (2.5th to 97.5th percentiles)

S_egg_comp.formula: mean(z(GREM1, HAS2, PTGS2, VCAN, CAMK1D, STC1, AREG, EREG, GJA1, GJA4, BMP15, GDF9))
S_egg_comp.high_score_meaning: Intact LH/EGF-like paracrine cascade (AREG/EREG), cumulus ECM expansion (HAS2/VCAN/PTGS2), gap-junctional coupling (GJA1/GJA4), and oocyte-secreted morphogen competence (BMP15/GDF9)

S_egg_mito.formula: mean(z(NAMPT, SIRT1, SIRT3, TFAM, PPARGC1A, SOD2, OPA1, SMC1B, REC8)) - z(CD38)
S_egg_mito.high_score_meaning: Preserved NAD+ salvage (NAMPT), mitochondrial biogenesis/sirtuin deacetylation (SIRT1/SIRT3/TFAM/PPARGC1A/OPA1/SOD2), and meiotic cohesin ring stability (SMC1B/REC8) uncoupled from CD38 NADase consumption

S_egg_ferro.formula: mean(z(GPX4, SLC7A11, FTH1, GCLC, NFE2L2)) - mean(z(ACSL4, ALOX15, PTGS2, TFRC))
S_egg_ferro.high_score_meaning: Robust glutathione/GPX4/ferritin anti-ferroptotic follicular shield against transferrin-iron import (TFRC) and PUFA lipid peroxidation (ACSL4/ALOX15)

S_sperm_act.formula: mean(z(PLCZ1, IZUMO1, CRISP2, HSPA2, PRKACA, SPACA3))
S_sperm_act.high_score_meaning: Intact acrosomal fusion (IZUMO1/SPACA3/CRISP2), chaperone-mediated zona recognition (HSPA2), and PLC-zeta (PLCZ1) IP3-Ca2+ oscillation trigger for oocyte activation

S_sperm_chrom.formula: mean(z(PRM1, PRM2, TNP1, TNP2, HILS1)) - abs(z(PRM1) - z(PRM2))
S_sperm_chrom.high_score_meaning: Complete histone-to-protamine toroid condensation with balanced 1:1 PRM1:PRM2 stoichiometry, protecting paternal DNA from oxidative fragmentation

S_sperm_mot.formula: mean(z(CATSPER1, CATSPER2, CATSPER3, CATSPER4, KCNU1, ADCY10, COX5B, ATP5F1A)) - mean(z(CASP3, BAX, CYCS))
S_sperm_mot.high_score_meaning: Intact CatSper Ca2+ channelosome / SLO3 (KCNU1) / sAC (ADCY10) flagellar hyperactivation and OXPHOS ATP drive without intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis

S_receptivity.formula: mean(z(PAEP, SPP1, LIF, GPX3, IGFBP1, PRL, FOXO1, HOXA10, HAND2, IL15))
S_receptivity.high_score_meaning: Synchronized mid-secretory Window of Implantation (WOI) epithelial secretion (PAEP/SPP1/LIF/GPX3), decidualization (IGFBP1/PRL/FOXO1/HOXA10/HAND2), and uNK recruitment (IL15)

S_senescent_decidua.formula: z(DIO2) - z(SCARA5)  [Extended: mean(z(DIO2, CLU, ABI3BP)) - mean(z(SCARA5, NCAM1, GNLY, GZMB))]
S_senescent_decidua.high_score_meaning: Door 1 Uterine Failure: Progesterone-resistant senescent decidual stroma (DIO2/CLU/ABI3BP high) with depleted SCARA5+ decidual cells and defective CD56bright uNK clearance (NCAM1/GNLY/GZMB low), driving tissue breakdown and RPL/early miscarriage

S_p4_resist.formula: mean(z(BCL6, SIRT1, KRAS, IL6, IL1B, TNF)) - mean(z(PGR, HAND2, HOXA10, FOXO1))
S_p4_resist.high_score_meaning: Door 2 Uterine Failure: Silent endometriosis / STAT3-driven BCL6-SIRT1-KRAS complex epigenetically silencing PGR and downstream HAND2/HOXA10/FOXO1 transcription amidst NF-kB cytokine inflammation (IL6/IL1B/TNF)

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_egg_comp (GREM1, HAS2, VCAN, AREG, BMP15, GDF9 collapse)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Immature GV/MI arrest, poor cumulus expansion, failed blastocyst formation
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Dual trigger (hCG + GnRH agonist) to rescue LH/EGF-like AREG/EREG surge; recombinant LH / hMG supplementation; IVM media supplemented with recombinant GDF9 + BMP15 (cumulin) + amphiregulin

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_egg_mito (NAMPT, SIRT3, TFAM, SMC1B, REC8 depletion / High CD38)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Advanced Maternal Age (AMA >=35-40y) meiotic spindle cohesin decay and aneuploidy
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Pre-retrieval NAD+ repletion (NMN / NR 500-1000 mg/d) + CD38 inhibition (apigenin / quercetin) + CoQ10 (ubiquinol 600 mg/d) + PQQ / melatonin to restore SIRT3/TFAM activity and protect REC8/SMC1B cohesin rings

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_egg_ferro (GPX4, SLC7A11, FTH1 collapse / High TFRC, ACSL4, ALOX15)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Diminished Ovarian Reserve (DOR) & PCOS follicular fluid oxidative/iron-driven granulosa ferroptosis
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: N-acetylcysteine (NAC 1800 mg/d to feed SLC7A11/glutathione) + Selenium/Vitamin E/Alpha-Lipoic Acid + follicular iron/lipid-peroxidation shielding (melatonin + resveratrol/curcumin NFE2L2 activation)

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_sperm_act (PLCZ1, IZUMO1, CRISP2, HSPA2, SPACA3 depletion)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Total Fertilization Failure (TFF) or <30% fertilization after conventional IVF / standard ICSI
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Mandatory ICSI + Artificial Oocyte Activation (AOA with calcium ionophore calcimycin A23187 or ionomycin / recombinant PLCZ1 rescue) + hyaluronic acid-bound sperm selection (PICSI for HSPA2+ mature sperm)

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_sperm_chrom (PRM1, PRM2, TNP1, TNP2 depletion or |z(PRM1)-z(PRM2)| imbalance)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Teratozoospermia, high Sperm DNA Fragmentation (DFI >25%), Day-3-to-Day-5 late paternal genome arrest
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Microfluidic sperm sorting (ZyMot) + short ejaculatory abstinence (12-24h) + oral antioxidant/methyl-donor regimen (L-carnitine, 5-MTHF, zinc, CoQ10) or testicular sperm extraction (TESE) in refractory post-testicular fragmentation

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_sperm_mot (CATSPER1-4, KCNU1, ADCY10, COX5B collapse / High BAX, CYCS, CASP3)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Asthenozoospermia, failed capacitation/hyperactivation, apoptotic ejaculated spermatozoa
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: ICSI bypass of zona penetration + MACS (annexin-V magnetic apoptotic sperm depletion) + in vitro pentoxifylline/theophylline/myo-inositol motility stimulation

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: Low S_receptivity (PAEP, SPP1, LIF, GPX3, IGFBP1, PRL, HOXA10, HAND2, IL15 collapse)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Displaced Window of Implantation (pre-receptive LH+2/LH+5 lag) and asynchronous secretory transition
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Personalized Embryo Transfer (pET) timing adjustment (+24h to +48h progesterone exposure) + luteal hCG/estradiol-progesterone synchronization

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: High Door 1: S_senescent_decidua (High DIO2, CLU, ABI3BP / Low SCARA5, NCAM1, GNLY, GZMB)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Decidual senescence & uNK clearance failure driving biochemical pregnancy and Recurrent Pregnancy Loss (RPL)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: Pre-conception luteal sitagliptin (DPP4 inhibitor to mobilize endometrial mesenchymal stem/progenitor cells and restore SCARA5+ decidua, per Brosens/Lucas trial) or senolytic clearance + luteal thyroid/local T3 (DIO2) normalization

biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.deficit_axis: High Door 2: S_p4_resist (High BCL6, SIRT1, KRAS, IL6, IL1B / Low PGR, HAND2, HOXA10, FOXO1)
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.clinical_phenotype: Silent endometriosis / adenomyosis progesterone resistance driving Recurrent Implantation Failure (RIF) and Unexplained Infertility
biomarker_to_intervention_routing_table.targeted_intervention: 60-day pre-transfer GnRH agonist depot (leuprolide) or oral GnRH antagonist (relugolix/elagolix) + aromatase inhibitor (letrozole 5 mg/d) to extinguish BCL6/SIRT1/KRAS before high-dose intramuscular + vaginal progesterone FET
